newsitem.title: USA: Micro Component sees lower Q1 revenues.
newsitem.headline: Micro Component sees lower Q1 revenues.

text.p: Micro Component Technology Inc said Tuesday it expects revenues in the first quarter, ended September 30, to be about 25 percent lower than earlier market expectations.
The company did not disclose market expectations for first quarter revenues.
Micro Component's net sales for the year-ago first quarter amounted to $6,890,000.
Micro Component makes automated test handling equipment for the global semiconductor industry.

"Numerous questions have arisen regarding the impact on MCT of announcements of weaker than anticipated market conditions by several major semiconductor equipment companies this quarter," Roger Gower, president, said in a statement. "In response, we too are being challenged by the weaker market and expect our revenues in the (fiscal first) quarter to be approximately 25 percent lower than earlier market expectations."
Longer-term, he added, Micro Component's new product introductions are being well accepted.
